findings.title: The find enters market accounting
findings.claim: The recovered person is recoded through concealment, merchandise, sale, price, deficit, dirham, and count: commercial precision makes the undervaluation administratively neat without making it just.
findings.mechanism: The context merchandise occurrence at 12:19 word 12 and concealment occurrence at word 11 contact the focus exchange, price, deficit, dirham, and counted modifier at 12:20. The chain changes a low price from an isolated appraisal into a sequence of reductions that turns a person into a measurable commodity.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see how the scene's exactness of currency and number intensifies, rather than repairs, the injustice of the diminished value.
findings.containment: The plain reading remains a sale for a low price. This finding does not prove every seller motive or activate every available commercial branch; it preserves only the supplied market chain.
